Equal Units per Pixel on x and y

Source: R/pointcloud.R
setEqualAspect.Rd

Makes one unit on the x axis as long on screen as one unit on the y axis, for maps, plans and images where x and y are the same kind of distance. The tighter axis is widened about its center; any limits from setAxisLimits still set where the view starts.

Usage

setEqualAspect(myIO, enabled = TRUE)

Arguments

myIO

A myIO widget.

enabled

TRUE (default) to turn equal aspect on, FALSE to turn it off.

Value

A modified myIO widget.

Examples

grid <- expand.grid(x = seq(0, 10, by = 0.5), y = seq(0, 4, by = 0.5))
grid$v <- grid$x * grid$y
myIO() |>
  addIoLayer(type = "raster", label = "v", data = grid,
             mapping = list(x_var = "x", y_var = "y", value = "v")) |>
  setEqualAspect()
